user.title: Seasonal Glass
user.description: Adds automatic seasonal decorations to your dashboards.

init.title: Seasonal Glass
init.description: What do you want to change? Remember to press **Save** at the end.

date.title: Period dates

colori.title: Colors
colori.description: Pick the period whose colors you want to change (✎ = changed).

colori_periodo.title: Colors
colori_periodo.description: {periodo}. **Main color**: buttons, switches, accents. **Tint**: semi-transparent color laid over the background; with only an intensity it uses the main color. Intensity 0 = no tint. Leave empty for the defaults.

ricorrenze.title: Personal days
ricorrenze.description: Birthdays, anniversaries and other days of yours: one per line, `MM-DD Name emoji #color` (emoji and color optional), e.g. `03-15 Marta's birthday 🎂 #8e44ad`. On that day the dashboards change color and confetti appears.

error.data_non_valida: Invalid date: use MM-DD or P-10 / P+3

preview.name: Preview period
preview.description: Shows a period on every device for a few minutes, then goes back to the automatic calendar.

period.name: Period
period.description: Period id (e.g. natale, halloween, capodanno, ricorrenza_1) or normal.
